assumptions: M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): The secret-scan regex thresholds are builder-chosen minimum length heuristics (AWS AKIA +16 chars; ghp_/github_pat_/sk- at 20+ chars; Slack xox*- tokens at 10+ chars; .env SECRET=TOKEN=PASSWORD=API_KEY lines with values of 12+ chars). They may need tightening after real-world false negative/positive feedback; none may ever be relaxed to log the secret value.

M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): everyone fan-out derives per-recipient idempotency keys as <base key>::<toAgent>; the double-colon separator is a builder choice, and changing it changes which retries dedupe.

M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): Claim globs (src/core/glob.ts) follow mk-like path-glob semantics without character classes: * matches within one path segment, ** matches across segments (including zero directories for **/), ? matches one non-separator character.

M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): Retention is keyed on messages.sent_at (PLAN 4.7 'older than 30 days' interpreted relative to send time), agreements.created_at, edits.at, and message-events are deleted with the messages that own them regardless of event time (keeps FKs safe).
M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): SQLite connections use WAL journal mode and a 5 s busy_timeout by default; concurrent writers wait briefly instead of failing immediately.
M1 (recorded 2026-11-07, fix session): A reply implies read (PLAN 4.3): delivered->replied is allowed and stamps read_at with the replied timestamp; read->replied keeps the earlier read_at.

M1 review round 1 disputed (opencode.json): the default-model change in opencode.json was requested by the user in chat and recorded as human_approved_exceptions in .workbench/tasks/M1/scope.json, but the record was written by an assistant session; the user should confirm the entry (or tell the workbench to forget it) in M2.

M2 (recorded 2026-11-07): MCP server identity defaults to PARLEY_AGENT_ID env, else harness@folder from PARLEY_HARNESS/cwd. Real adapters (M4+) replace this. Tool-definition tokens estimated at chars/4 (project's own cost model) over JSON.stringify of listTools output; budget is 1,500, measured ~518. Agreement recipient is derived as the latest direct message recipient in the thread. Counter-proposal marks the original 'countered' and inserts a new 'offered' row with parent_id. Rules-file text goes out once per inbox session (ctx.rulesTextSent). wait_for_reply_s polls findLatestReplyTo at 25 ms intervals.

M3 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): The CLI bin entry src/cli/bin.ts exists but the package.json `bin` field and the compiled path are deferred to M12, since there is no build pipeline yet.

M4 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): User-level Claude Code MCP registration is written to ~/.claude.json under the top-level `mcpServers` key (verified against the official MCP scope docs + current third-party guides, NOT the ~/.claude/settings.json file). M4 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): Hook logic lives in TypeScript (src/cli/commands/hook-events.ts + hook-payloads.ts); the plugin's shell scripts only pipe stdin JSON into `parley-mcp hook <event>`. A payload carrying agent_id or agent_type is treated as a subagent event and ignored by every handler (PLAN section 6). The Parley agent id is derived as `claude@<basename(cwd)>` from the hook payload's cwd; the monitor derives the same id from its own $PWD because it gets no session_id. These id-derivation and the monitor's parent-pid/stdout-notification behaviour are ASSUMED and must be confirmed in the human's live two-session test.

M4 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): Read-evidence from UserPromptSubmit marks a message read when the message id appears in the prompt text; a still-`sent` message seen in the prompt is delivered-then-read so the guarded state machine moves it legally. Whether Claude naturally echoes a delivered message id into its next prompt is unverified; the monitor line includes the id so it can. Fallback: an unechoed message stays `delivered` (intended, PLAN 4.3).

M4 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro): DoctorReport gained an optional `hooksTrusted: boolean | null`; the Claude Code adapter reports `null` (plugins/monitors need no per-hook trust). The Adapter interface's install(env, dryRun)/method(env) signatures widen PLAN section 6's zero-arg sketch for testability (temp HOME); documented in src/adapters/types.ts. src/adapters/claude-code/fixtures/*.json are synthetic (marked _synthetic:true) until the human captures real anonymised payloads.

[autonomous] 2026-11-07: The M4 plugin-loading fix is held until the round-1 reviewer finishes, so the reviewer reads a stable tree; then plugin loading and the review findings go to the builder as one fix.

M4 fix (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix): The Claude Code plugin is installed via a local directory marketplace at ~/.parley-mcp/claude-marketplace/ (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json + plugins/parley/), because a folder under ~/.claude/plugins does NOT load (confirmed in .workbench/tasks/M4/plugin-loading.md). install/uninstall/doctor shell out to `claude plugin validate|marketplace add|install|uninstall|marketplace remove|list --json` through an injectable CommandRunner (src/adapters/claude-code/runner.ts); the real runner spawns `claude` and was NOT run by the build. The `claude plugin list --json` output shape is unverified and parsed defensively (name/plugin, enabled/disabled/status, array or {plugins:[]}); if the CLI is unreachable doctor reports cannot-wake-idle rather than a false positive. ASSUMED until the human's live test: that these exact `claude plugin` subcommands/flags match the installed CLI and that `plugin install --scope user` enables the plugin.

This replaces the earlier implicit mcp@<folder> identity for Claude sessions.

M4 fix (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix): SessionEnd now requeues only messages whose delivered_session equals the ending session (requeueDeliveredToSession); the older requeueDeliveredForSession(exceptSession) is retained for the PLAN 4.3 'fresh session requeue' path but is not yet wired to a hook. Hook handlers write diagnostics to a stderr `status` channel (CliDeps.status / HookEventDeps.status / HookEditDeps.status) so a Claude Code hook's stdout stays empty except genuine deliveries. The monitor script calls `inbox register` (idempotent) and loops rather than exiting if the agent isn't registered yet.

M4 fix (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix): The Stop hook's use of last_assistant_message as read evidence (flagged by the reviewer as beyond PLAN 4.3) was REMOVED, not kept: read evidence is now only a message id in a UserPromptSubmit prompt, an inbox call, or a reply. The fakeAdapter was removed from the production ADAPTERS list (src/adapters/index.ts) and is imported directly in tests; setup/uninstall/doctor accept an injectable adapters list that defaults to the production list.

Setup writes a launcher at ~/.mcp-parley/bin/mcp-parley (src/adapters/cli-path.ts) that runs THIS install's CLI by absolute path, and the MCP entry, every hook script, the monitor and the fake adapter's config use that absolute launcher path. M4 fix2 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix2): PostToolUse and Stop hooks no longer drain (they only heartbeat; PostToolUse also records edits). `additionalContext` for PostToolUse is documented but not reliably surfaced to the model (public bug report), so a drained-but-unshown message would be a silent loss. The monitor is the single mid-turn delivery path (its printed body wakes the session at a safe point). A test proves a mid-turn message stays `sent` through PostToolUse+Stop and is then surfaced/delivered by `inbox drain`.

M4 fix2 (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix2): The monitor passes --session monitor-$$ (its own PID) to `inbox drain`, so monitor deliveries record delivered_session and the session-scoped requeue acts on them; ASSUMED stable for the monitor process's life. readPluginState now requires explicit enabled evidence (enabled:true / disabled:false / status:'enabled') and matches by id/name/parley@parley — a missing enabled/disabled/status field no longer counts as enabled. The exact `claude plugin list --json` shape is still unverified (assumed: array OR {plugins:[...]}, each {name|id|plugin, enabled|disabled|status}).

M4 fix2 DEVIATION (recorded 2026-11-07, kiro-M4-fix2): PLAN section 6 describes agent registration as a SessionStart concern, but the monitor also self-registers `claude@<basename(pwd)>` in EVERY folder it runs in. Why: it must survive the start-of-session race where the monitor starts before the SessionStart hook has registered the agent (otherwise `inbox drain` would have no agent and the first messages would be lost). It is idempotent and never deletes, so the only effect is that a folder with a running Claude session always has a registered agent even if SessionStart was missed. Accepted as intentional.

The misleading test (called requeueDeliveredToSession('monitor-7') directly) was replaced by two tests driving runHookSessionEnd/runHookSessionStart with realistic Claude session ids. ASSUMED: the monitor's PID-based session id always matches 'monitor-%' (set in the monitor script); confirmed in the human's live test (PROGRESS step 8).
